text:
maya: seeing multiple customer reports of p95/p99 spikes from /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 since 08:12 UTC. customer-xyz (support #3241) shows p99 ~4.2s (baseline ~600ms). logs point to increased queuing on gpu-pool-eu-2.

sam: looking now. I can repro on staging with a synthetic load. Traces show long wait in request-queue -> batching delay. p95 shifted too. Suspect autoscaler policy rolled around 08:05.

ryan: rolling back autoscaler policy to autoscale-threshold-v2 now. Will monitor. Also propose emergency fallback to fallback-model-small in eu-west to keep tail bounded.

maya: agreed. Mitigation plan (short):
  1) Enable circuit-breaker for embeddings route: trigger when median latency >2s for 5m -> start returning 503 w/ Retry-After 5s and route to fallback model for best-effort.
  2) Add fallback routing to smaller model + route to eu-central if eu-west pool unhealthy.
  3) Apply soft per-customer token throttle (100 r/s) to reduce noisy tenants.

infra-bot: Deploy start: rollback-autoscaler-policy@prod by ryan. ID: deploy_789.

sam: temp admin command to prefer eu-central fallback region: `curl -X POST "https://console.internal/admin/routes" -d '{"route":"embeddings","fallback_region":"eu-central-1"}'` (will propagate in ~30s).

maya: also enable KV prefix cache TTL 600s for common prefixes (reduces cold-kv misses). Sam/Ryan: can we cut max_batch_tokens 4096 -> 2048 to reduce batching delay?

ryan: applied max_batch_tokens -> 2048 on eu pools (rolling).

sam: dashboards: queue length dropping, p99 trending down to ~800ms. Seeing a small increase in 429s from the temp rate limit — expected.

maya: please notify CS with mitigation summary and ETA. If p99 >1.5s after 20m, escalate to infra-scaling (add 2 nodes) or failover traffic to eu-central fallback.

olivia: I'll send CS note now. Draft: "We observed a transient capacity-related tail latency spike impacting embeddings in eu-west-1. We rolled back a recent autoscaler change, applied rate-limits, and enabled a fallback model; latency is improving. We’ll follow up with root cause and remediation plan."

ryan: post-mortem TODOs: pin autoscaler config, add canary gates for autoscaler rollouts, add percentile-based circuit-breaker (p95/p99 thresholds), add automated fallback to region when node pool queue > X, run load test simulating prefix-cache miss patterns.

maya: +1. Closure criteria: CS updated and p99 <1s for 30m. Will re-open if regression. :thumbsup:

sam: noted. Monitoring alert muted to avoid spam, leaving paging enabled for p99 >2.5s.

infra-bot: Deploy success: rollback-autoscaler-policy@prod completed (deploy_789).

maya: thanks team — keeping this open until CS ack and stable metrics.
